column5: North Bristol Private Hospital - out-of-hours enquiries
column7: Self-pay surgery runs into five figures per case. An enquiry that goes unanswered over a weekend is a lost operation, not a lost call.

column5: Quick question about 58 Queen Square's enquiry handling
column7: Cosmetic surgery consultations convert slowly and enquirers shop around. Speed of first reply decides who gets the consultation.

column5: Quick question about My Cosmetics Clinic's enquiry handling
column7: Manchester surgical clinic; consultations are the bottleneck and enquirers shop around while they wait.

column5: Quick question about The Private Clinic's enquiry handling
column7: Multi-site group with national advertising spend. Every unanswered enquiry is paid-for traffic wasted.

column5: Quick question about UKSKIN's enquiry handling
column7: Surgery hubs in Birmingham, London and Manchester. Multi-site enquiry routing done by hand is where paid-for leads get lost.

column5: Bath Spa Dentistry - out-of-hours enquiries
column7: City-centre private practice; enquiries arrive while the chair is occupied.

column5: Clifton Dental Studio - out-of-hours enquiries
column7: Implant and cosmetic cases run to four and five figures. A missed call about implants is a £5,000 case going to another practice.

column5: Quick question about Contemporary Dental's enquiry handling
column7: Private practice in Devon with a wide catchment - patients travel, so a slow reply loses them to somewhere closer.

column5: Green Park Dental - out-of-hours enquiries
column7: Cosmetic and implant work from whitening through to veneers and implants - four-figure cases where the first reply usually wins.

column5: Quick question about Infinity Dental Clinic's enquiry handling
column7: Cosmetic-led Leeds clinic where treatment plans need chasing to convert.

column5: Meliora Dental - out-of-hours enquiries
column7: Implant-focused Leeds practice; the same four-figure-case logic applies.

column5: Park Place Dental - out-of-hours enquiries
column7: Implant-led Cardiff practice. Implant cases are four and five figures, so a missed enquiry is an expensive one.

column5: Quick question about South Wales Specialist Oral Surgery's enquiry handling
column7: Specialist oral surgery and implant centre taking referrals as well as direct enquiries - two intake streams, both manual.

column5: Quick question about Somerset Bridge Group's enquiry handling
column7: Brokers lose 29-39 hours a week to admin, 8-10 of that on email alone. Their revenue is commission and renewals, so every hour reclaimed converts directly.

column5: Sifting CVs at Future Engineering Recruitment Ltd
column7: Placement fees run to five figures. Consultants lose hours a day to reading CVs that were never a fit.

column5: Sifting CVs at Pamela Neave
column7: Independent consultancy where the founder is still fee-earning. Screening time comes straight out of billing time.

column5: Quick question about Bristol Aesthetics's enquiry handling
column7: Treatment-led clinic with repeat-course revenue that depends on rebooking, which is exactly what gets forgotten.

column5: Quick question about Paul Wilson Aesthetics's enquiry handling
column7: Consultant-led aesthetics: the surgeon is in clinic all day and cannot answer enquiries while operating.

column5: Quick question about Skin & Joints's enquiry handling
column7: Clinician-led practice where the person delivering treatment is also the person answering the phone.

column5: Quick question about Avenue Veterinary Centre's enquiry handling
column7: Independent practice - increasingly rare, as most UK vets are now group-owned with central procurement. Independent means the owner can still decide.

column5: Charlton Baker - chasing records before January
column7: Nine offices across the South West and Thames Valley. Records chasing multiplies with every location.

column5: Milsted Langdon LLP - chasing records before January
column7: Five offices and a January deadline crush. Chasing clients for records is the single biggest drain in the practice.

column5: Quick question about AMD Solicitors's enquiry handling
column7: Multi-office firm; the same update calls repeat across every branch.

column5: Quick question about Watkins Solicitors's enquiry handling
column7: Conveyancing clients ring constantly for progress updates. That traffic is pure cost and it lands on fee earners.
